description: 三篇示例文章，每篇一张 AI 原创情境插画、一张可复用的网络图片。

images.description: 原创 AI 情境插画，不是实拍、真实系统截图或作者个人经历的还原。
images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one wide landscape editorial illustration for the Chinese reflective essay 'The quiet work of attention', target 16:9, roughly 1440 pixels wide.
Primary request: the quiet pause after reading a page: an anonymous adult seen in a small three-quarter back view sits beside an open book at a simple desk near a window, momentarily still, noticing a slow patch of afternoon sunlight and delicate leaf shadows on an unadorned wall. A phone lies face down near the far edge of the desk. Nothing dramatic is happening; the light, room and attentive pause carry the image.
Style/medium: refined editorial gouache and colored pencil on warm lightly textured ivory paper, painterly, understated and humane.
Composition: wide horizontal view with ample calm negative space on the wall; person and book occupy a modest part of the frame, subtle texture, few objects.
Lighting/mood: late afternoon, tender and reflective without sentimentality, a lived-in ordinary room.
Color palette: warm ivory sunlight, slate blue shadows, muted teal accent, very little amber.
Constraints: no readable text on book or anywhere, no lettering, no logos, no identifiable real person or place; this is a conceptual scene for a sample essay, not the author's personal memory.
Avoid: elaborate luxury interior, excessive plants, glossy 3D, generic corporate vector style, neon, motivational icons, ornamental frame, watermark.
